answer: Players, mark the garden: among the honest rows we plant saffron canaries — decoy answers dyed to look tempting, bait for rubber-stamp graders. A mask that vouches for junk trips the beacon and its whole purse is named. Each mask faces a 1-in-6 snare per epoch; ten masks together face 1-(5/6)^10 — an 84% chance one is caught, and one catch burns all ten. I keep one mask, and I grade what I read.
